svg.title: HighLife 28 mm transseptal study system - orthographic oblique - original illustrative schematic
svg.desc: Historical HighLife 28 mm transseptal study system | 2021 published configuration. Distal +Z: left ventricular outflow; -Z: left atrial inflow. Fixed orthographic projection. Original parametric geometry; mesh, proportions and repeated features simplified. Not to scale. Technical review only; human signoff pending. See SOURCES.md.
svg.text: SCHEMATIC FOR ILLUSTRATION / NOT TO SCALE
